name: Transient route → PARK: transient cap reached → park toward the human
description:
The transient-exhaustion park (adopt-reason-aware-escalate, #529/#569/SB5). When a developer loop failed for a TRANSIENT reason (route.attempt.transient=true) AND the transient-retry grace is exhausted (route.transient.instance count ≥ CAP=2), the endpoint is persistently failing — PARK toward the human rather than retry unbounded (the bounded-loop invariant, extended to the transient track). This is distinct from the convergence escalate (06d): the run did not fail to CONVERGE, its loops kept dying on infrastructure, so the park names the TRANSIENT reason and tells the human a re-run may just work once the endpoint recovers.

TRIGGER = the developer loop L_n: route.attempt.transient eq "true" (the check_floors ATOMIC-MIRROR classification of the loop's terminal reason, stamped in the SAME ReplaceTriples as route.attempt.passed — see 06f for why it is never a rule-stamped collapse) AND route.attempt.unclean eq "true" (the shared not-clean trigger — see 06f for the totality argument: a passed=false gate leaves the passed=true∧rejected=true∧transient=true cell unrouted) AND route.transient.instance length_gte 2 (required:true — cap reached, fail-closed; #568 length_gte against the LITERAL cap) AND route.attempt.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). Mutually exclusive with the transient-retry (06f, length_lt 2) on the transient count.

WRITER: run.awaiting.human — a sanctioned park realization (G5), same meaning as the others, differing only in trigger. REASON-AWARE (#569): the object carries $entity.triple.agent.loop.terminal-reason.value (the transient reason), resolved firing-entity-only on this developer loop (no mirror); G3 — the engine's classified fact, never synthesized.

RUN BINDING: the park marker goes on the RUN (subject-override this developer loop L_n's agent.run.entity-id).

SELF-EXTINGUISHING: route.attempt.routed on L_n (a LOOP-scoped guard — the loop does not carry the run-scoped park marker).

on_enter.subject: $entity.triple.agent.run.entity-id
on_enter.object: the dev loop kept failing on TRANSIENT infrastructure errors and reached the transient-retry cap; last engine terminal reason: '$entity.triple.agent.loop.terminal-reason.value' (model_error/handler_error — a re-run may succeed once the endpoint recovers)

metadata.station: transient park — transient cap reached → park toward the human (adopt-reason-aware-escalate/SB5)
metadata.trigger_rationale: route.attempt.transient eq true (the atomic check_floors mirror flag) AND route.attempt.unclean eq true AND route.transient.instance length_gte 2 (cap reached). Partitions the transient count with 06f's length_lt 2; length_gte is fail-closed (catches an over-count too).
metadata.reason_aware: the run.awaiting.human object substitutes $entity.triple.agent.loop.terminal-reason.value (firing-entity-only, #569/#519) so the human knows the failures were transient infrastructure, not non-convergence.
metadata.writer_note: run.awaiting.human is written by the park-rule subsystem (G5) — a sanctioned park realization. Rule add_triple carries no Source, so the single vocab entry is not drifted.
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the LOOP-scoped route.attempt.routed marker (not run.awaiting.human, which lives on the run).
